trajectory_classification.label: MEMORY SIGNAL ACCELERATING
trajectory_classification.rule: Let q25, q50, q100 be shuffled-minus-real recovery at 25M, 50M, 100M. DISAPPEARING if q100<=0 or q100<0.5*q25; SATURATING if q100>0 and the 50M-to-100M gain is <=25% of max(q50-q25,1e-12); ACCELERATING if q100>q50>q25 and (q100-q50)>(q50-q25); otherwise STRENGTHENING.
